name: Jarinko Chie: Bakudan Musume no Shiawase Sagashi
original_name: じゃりン子チエ ばくだん娘の幸せさがし
source:
First you help those who in trouble as Chie, then as a lost cat searching for way back and finally as Chie's father Tetsu with money being the main theme.

Based on the gag manga.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
首先你会扮演Chie帮助那些陷入困境的人，然后扮演一只迷路的猫寻找回家的路，最后扮演Chie的父亲Tetsu，以金钱为主题。

根据搞笑漫画改编。

[来自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
